identity.display_name: 地府战斗机制与可读性合同

source_artifacts: 地府战斗机制与可读性规格.md

party_cap.rule: every encounter provides a one-to-four-player completion path; cooperation can parallelize observation or protection but cannot create a fifth-player-only solution

hard_boundaries.authority_rule: combat readability only describes visible pressure, player judgment, counterplay and review; it cannot write progression, mutate membership, issue a receipt, settle a reward, or alter cleanup semantics
hard_boundaries.runtime_asset_rule: no map, terrain, unit, ability, item, buff, projectile, UI control, Lua, storage, timer, resource key, Y3 object or actual runtime state is created
hard_boundaries.economy_rule: no XP, currency, material, equipment, artifact, drop, pity, qualification, receipt or reward value is defined or emitted

readability_grammar.dual_channel_rule: critical truth, priority, route, target and restoration state require a visual_or_spatial channel plus an independent audio_or_ui_or_state_change channel; color alone is forbidden
readability_grammar.failure_rule: failure must identify a missed, misread, mistimed or wrongly prioritized evidence decision; unexplained instant loss is forbidden

warning.visual_or_spatial: two distinguishable soul-mark states and route projections
warning.audio_or_ui_or_state_change: directional cue or priority UI state

encounters.player_decision: verify which soul-mark is forged, choose which pressure may be deferred, and return the confirmed target to the guiding chain
encounters.visible_restoration: the forged pull is rejected and the confirmed target gains a readable guiding route
encounters.failure_meaning: the player treated apparent threat as proof or discarded the second record before verification
encounters.review: show the misread soul-mark, missed priority clue and an alternative order of verification

encounters.display_name: 鬼门关：通行与守门压力

warning.visual_or_spatial: blocked lawful passage, false escort direction and guard formation are separately readable
warning.audio_or_ui_or_state_change: gate command, lock state or passage UI cue

encounters.player_decision: protect a lawful route, intercept a false escort, defer pressure, or recover a verifiable gate credential
encounters.visible_restoration: the lawful passage becomes readable and the false escort loses its transit basis
encounters.failure_meaning: the player only fought guards or forced a gate while the wrong passage continued to consume the route
encounters.review: show the misjudged passage, unaddressed closure and a recoverable retreat_or_review route

warning.visual_or_spatial: soul-mark origin, absence or conflict relation

encounters.player_decision: compare an origin, temporarily hold a contested soul, submit a verified guidance, or refuse forged ownership
encounters.visible_restoration: matching soul-marks gain correct guidance while conflicting records remain visibly available for correction
encounters.failure_meaning: the player substituted appearance, distance or threat for identity verification
encounters.review: show the missing comparison, wrong submission and the source that should have been checked first

warning.visual_or_spatial: rewritten entries, contradictory evidence and forced judgment chain
warning.audio_or_ui_or_state_change: page_sound, verdict voice or evidence summary

encounters.player_decision: choose a causal chain to proofread, defer a judgment, submit a verified entry, or protect an unaltered record
encounters.visible_restoration: false entries lose coercive effect and the verified causal chain persists for the next decision
encounters.failure_meaning: the player affirmed a forged entry before proof or ignored a contradiction that later overwrote the record
encounters.review: show the false entry accepted, omitted contradiction and a better proofreading order

encounters.display_name: 白骨秘境：单人多形态识别

warning.visual_or_spatial: shared soul-mark, behavior trace or scene residue persists before a form changes

encounters.player_decision: identify whether a form conceals, lures or exposes evidence; observe, evade, interrupt, retain evidence or submit during restoration
encounters.visible_restoration: the same-source evidence remains continuous across forms and reveals the next readable clue
encounters.failure_meaning: the player treated a form change as a new target or submitted judgment during concealment
encounters.review: show recognized and missed same-source clues in a form sequence

encounters.display_name: 阎罗殿：证据与裁决的常规最终

warning.visual_or_spatial: overwriting fate-record entries, provenance paths and contested judgment zones
warning.audio_or_ui_or_state_change: verdict cadence, bell or judgment summary

encounters.player_decision: preserve a verifiable entry, defer a false judgment, choose an evidence-backed verdict and reject a forged final archive
encounters.visible_restoration: a verified record persists, false coercion loses effect and the fate record visibly returns to a coherent order
encounters.failure_meaning: the player misread proof, chose a wrong priority or missed a restoration opportunity rather than merely lacking output
encounters.review: replay the final truth-versus-forgery divergence and the omitted preservation_or_restoration action

encounters.display_name: 转轮殿：记忆与轮回协作

warning.visual_or_spatial: memory chains, false member categorization and rebirth direction are readable on the scene
warning.audio_or_ui_or_state_change: distinct memory cues, responsibility UI or narration

encounters.player_decision: assign observation, protection, memory recovery and restoration roles; decide when to aggregate evidence and when to defer a chain
encounters.visible_restoration: mutually verified memory chains resist reset and a false rebirth push loses its basis
encounters.failure_meaning: the group chose speed over verification, erased a chain by misclassification, or mistook deferral for abandonment
encounters.review: show omitted evidence, premature restoration and a recoverable cooperation order by responsibility

handoff_boundaries.terrain: future terrain must expose evidence origin, deferral space, handoff route, restoration window and retreat/review sightline; coordinates and map bindings remain deferred
handoff_boundaries.object_config: future assets need soul-mark, fate-record, gate-credential and memory-chain silhouettes plus dual-channel telegraph roles; object IDs and properties remain deferred
handoff_boundaries.lua: future runtime may consume authoritative encounter outcomes but cannot derive admission, completion, membership, reconnect, cleanup, receipt or settlement from this contract
handoff_boundaries.ui: future UI may display evidence priority, judgment state and failure review; it cannot decide truth, entry, member state, progression or settlement
